record.title: Prepare complete acquired catalog capability arms
record.intent: Test interaction of the complete acquired ordinary catalog with explicit capability selection.
requirements: Bind and independently verify the final acquired BWU03T08 run seal and its install/process/reboot evidence before copying all ten ordinary licenses, witnesses, exact acquired key and modeled private state.

Create a separate reload-only combined-catalog profile. Preserve existing catalog and FlexA capability contracts. Stock requires enum17 and row0x151b7a0; derived requires enum18 and row0x151b850 with public MHO984 identity.

Only the pinned 27 changed bytes within the admitted32-byte native span may differ in a disposable derived copy; preserve stock originals and all identity/license files. Retain full catalog consumer evidence, zero installer/producer calls and bounded guest confinement.
Implement independent verification and host negative controls for source lineage, native pin, profile, catalog and seed preservation. Commit and push preparation before guest execution.
acceptance: The bounded transition and evidence limits are recorded.
